description:
The Bug:
Falling sand creates invisible blocks.
Steps to Reproduce:
- Run the following command whilst standing on a stone block.

```
/summon minecraft:falling_block ~ ~-1 ~ {Time:1,Motion:[0.0,1.0,0.0],BlockState:{Name:"minecraft:stone"}}
```
- Take note as to whether or not falling sand creates invisible blocks.

Observed Behavior:
Falling sand creates invisible blocks.
Expected Behavior:
Falling sand would not be able to create invisible blocks.
Code Analysis:
Code analysis by  can be found in this comment.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Enter a Minecraft world and stand on a stone block.
2. Open the chat and enter `/summon minecraft:falling_block ~ ~-1 ~ {Time:1,Motion:[0.0,1.0,0.0],BlockState:{Name:"minecraft:stone"}}`.
3. Execute the command.
4. Observe that the falling sand creates invisible blocks.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.8, 1.8.1, 1.8.2-pre4, 1.8.8, 15w37a, 15w47c, 1.9 Pre-Release 4, 1.9, 1.9.4, 16w21b, 1.10.2, 16w43a, 1.12, 1.12.1, 1.12.2, 18w16a, 1.13.1, 1.13.2, 18w48a, 18w48b, 18w49a, 18w50a, 1.14.1, 1.14.2 Pre-Release 2, 1.14.2 Pre-Release 3, 1.14.2 Pre-Release 4, 1.14.4, 19w39a, 1.15.1, 20w13a, 20w17a, 1.16.1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4, 20w46a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w08b, 21w10a, 21w11a, 21w13a, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 21w19a, 21w20a, 1.17 Pre-release 1, 1.17 Pre-release 3, 1.17 Pre-release 4, 1.17 Pre-release 5, 1.17 Release Candidate 1, 1.17 Release Candidate 2, 1.17, 1.17.1 Pre-release 1, 1.17.1 Pre-release 2, 1.17.1 Pre-release 3, 1.17.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.17.1, 21w37a, 21w38a, 21w39a, 21w40a, 21w41a, 21w42a, 21w43a, 1.18 Pre-release 1, 1.18 Pre-release 7, 1.18 Release Candidate 3, 1.18, 1.18.1 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: Executing the command summons a `minecraft:falling_block` entity with a stone `BlockState`. After the entity moves upward and returns to the supporting stone block, it places a stone block that is not rendered. The resulting invisible block still occupies the block position and behaves as a solid block, despite having no visible stone model.
Expected Behavior: When a falling sand block is summoned and lands on a solid block, it should not create an invisible block. The resulting block should remain visible and render correctly as the specified block, such as stone, without leaving behind an unseen solid obstruction or otherwise altering the surrounding world unexpectedly.
